# An effect in a component built at run time, keyed on a call that reads a
# package var written outside it -- `current()`, and `scaled(2)` through it --
# runs when the var is written: its `@update`, the remount of a keyed
# `@mount`, and a query asking again, for the one instance under an `if` and
# for every copy under a `for`. passEffectOutsideKeys moved only a var the key
# named, so the page marked the instance's flag by bare name: fyne, gtk4 and
# android did not build, and html built and ran none of it. The key now calls
# a copy of each func that takes the var as a parameter, handed the instance's
# prop. The page's own `current()` still reads the var. The interpreter ran no
# `@update` for such a key either (testdata/effect_update_through_call.sngl).
# effect_keyed_on_package_var_runs.txt is the key naming the var.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

var level = 0
var asked list[int] = []
var mounts list[int] = []

func current() => level

func scaled(k int) => current() * k

func lookup(n int) async.Result[string] {
    asked.push(n)
    return {ok="level {n}"}
}

component gauge ui.node {
    var seen = 0
    var twice = 0
    var answer option[string] = null

    effect(on=current(), @update(n) {
        seen = n
    })
    effect(on=scaled(2), @update(n) {
        twice = n
    })
    effect(on=current(), @mount(n) {
        mounts.push(n)
    })
    async.query(on=current(), fetch=lookup, :value=answer)
    ui.text #shown(value=answer != null ? answer : "-")
}

component app ui.node {
    var open = true
    var copies = [1, 2]

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #raise(text="raise", @click {
            level += 1
        })
        ui.text #now(value="{current()}")
        if open {
            gauge #g
        }
        for var k = copies {
            gauge #row
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    app()
}

func testAWriteOutsideReachesTheEffect(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.assert(c.now.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.g != null && c.g.seen == 1 && c.g.twice == 2)
    t.assert(c.row[0].seen == 1 && c.row[1].seen == 1)
    t.assert(c.row[0].twice == 2 && c.row[1].twice == 2)
}

func testAWriteOutsideRemountsAKeyedEffect(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.assert(mounts.format(",") == "0,0,0,1,1,1")
}

func testAWriteOutsideAsksTheQueryAgain(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.g != null && c.g.answer != null && c.g.answer == "level 1", 2000)
    t.assert(asked.format(",") == "0,0,0,1,1,1")
}
